system.description:
Choose one from [Rigor], [Staggered], [Dazed], [Confusion], [Decay], or [Afflicted]. Targets remove the chosen status during the Cleanup Process of every round.

(Effect): While this [Harmony] is in effect, increase your [Hate] by +1 during the Cleanup Process of every round.

A support song that heals the ailment of allies by playing a light dance song that activates vitality.
